properties.decision: Accepted the structural defect heal:f737a5cdf35a906d (single point of failure: cmp:ingest).
properties.name: Reviewed: heal:f737a5cdf35a906d
properties.rationale: Carries dec:sanitize-spof-accepted (2026-07-25): true and expected — cmp:sanitize is reached only through cmp:ingest, because INGEST is the only path foreign text currently enters by, so every route to the trust boundary runs through one component. `add_redundancy` is the wrong shape (a second copy of a pure text filter is duplication, not resilience). What dissolves it is the SECOND CALLER: detect-and-report on graph import. Deliberately NOT wiring cmp:export to cmp:sanitize to quiet the detector, because that edge does not exist in the code.
